name: ui-toggle-morph
title: Toggle Morph
description: Con trỏ bấm, núm trượt sang bằng lò xo có vọt nhẹ và bẹp theo tốc độ, rãnh chuyển màu, OFF đổi thành ON và dấu tích vẽ ra trong núm.

moworks.author: moworks

options.onAt: s (0.5): spring k300 c20, about 10 % over
options.squash: scaleX per px a second (0.0005), at most 0.16
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Track 120x56 r28, grey → accent crossfade with knob progress. Knob circle r22 travels x +56 px on spring(k300, c20) from 0.5 s (about 10 % overshoot); back at 1.9 s on spring(k420, c40). Knob squash: scaleX = 1 + min(0.16, speed × 0.02), scaleY inverse. Check stroke draws inside the knob as progress goes 0.35 → 1; OFF fades out, ON fades in. Cursor arrives 0.05-0.4 s (power2.out), presses at 0.47 and 1.87 s, leaves 2.3-2.75 s. Params: travel (56 px) · spring on (k300 c20) · spring off (k420 c40) · squash (tối đa 0.16) · at.
moworks.titleVi: Công tắc gạt, núm có dấu tích
